heroSubheading: We stock STIHL and service all outdoor power gear for the Mosgiel district
aboutHtml:
We're David Hay and Andrew Allan, locals who've lived and worked in the district for many years. We built this shop to serve our community with quality STIHL equipment and expert service.

We stock the full STIHL range including chainsaws, mowers, hedge trimmers, blowers, water blasters and more for homeowners, contractors, farmers and businesses. Our fully equipped workshop provides service and repair for STIHL and other outdoor power brands with our factory-trained technicians. You can try battery-powered equipment at home with our loaner kit before deciding what to buy.

Come in and see what we have in the showroom or talk through what you need. We're here to give you sound advice and keep your gear running well for years to come.
